{{Update |title1 = v1.63.0 |image1 = SwarmerReworkThumbnail.png |release_date = 30 April 2025 (v1.63.0) |minor_updates = v1.63.0a (2 May 2025) |feed_title = 🐝 Swarmer Rework |feed_color = Beige |previous_update = [[v1.62.0]] |next_update = [[v1.64.0]] }} ==Description== '''v1.63.0''' is the one hundred and fourteenth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 30th of April 2025. The update was mostly about the reworked [[Swarmer]]. This version encompassed two updates, the main v1.63.0 (released 30 April 2025) and the minor v1.63.0a (released 2 May 2025). ==Additions== *[[Legacy Space City]] (Survival & Hardcore) ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Swarmer]] reworked. **[[Swarmer]] is now purchasable through a gamepass for {{Robux|799}}. **Main attack now deals damage. **Now always target enemies based on its targeting rather than trying to apply its debuff to every enemy at once. **Effects from multiple [[Swarmer]]s now stack. ***Each individual [[Swarmer]] now has a stack limit of 150. ***Stack limit for all [[Swarmer]]s is 5,000. ***Stack count is now displayed under enemy health. ***''Bee Swarm Grenade'' now can be thrown at enemies that are being currently stung. **[[Swarmer]] no longer waits five seconds for an enemy to enter its range after ''Bee Swarm Grenade'' is used, now it will throw its grenade at a random spot on the path if there are no enemies in range. **Now only one stinging time from an effect is active at once for an enemy. Previously, another effect being applied would extend the effect and the entire stack would disappear once it ends. **Sting damage now has regular [[Damage Indicators]] instead of poison [[Damage Indicators]]. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|300}} to {{Money|450}}. ****Damage decreased from 2 to 1. ****Bee damage decreased from 2 to 1. ****Range increased from 12 to 14. ***'''Level 1''' ****Damage increased from +0 to +1. ****Bee damage increased from +0 to +1. ****Tick changed from 1 > 0.75 to 1. ****Name changed from ''Aggressive Bees'' to ''Extra Honey''. ***'''Level 2''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|350}} to {{Money|500}}. ****Range decreased from +4 to +2. ****Damage increased from +0 to +2. ****Tick changed from 0.75 to 1 > 0.75. ****Sting time changed from 4 to 4 > 4.5. ****Name changed from ''Improve Handling'' to ''Agressive Bees''. ***'''Level 3''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|500}} to {{Money|1,500}}. ****Firerate changed from {{Tooltip|1.525 > 1.025|-0.5}} to {{Tooltip|1.525 > 1.275|-0.25}}. ****Range increased from +2 to +3. ****Damage increased from +0 to +6. ****Sting time changed from 4 to 4.5 > 5.25. ****''Bee Swarm Grenade'' unlocked, moved from Level 4. *****Explosion range decreased from 10 to 6. *****No longer has damage drop off. *****Name changed from ''Beehive Grenade'' to ''Bee Swarm Grenade''. ****Name changed from ''Bee Gun'' to ''Bee Certified Weapons''. ***'''Level 4''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|1,400}} to {{Money|3,000}}. ****Firerate changed from 1.025 to {{Tooltip|1.275 > 1.025|-0.25}}. ****Range increased from +0 to +2. ****Damage increased from +0 to +5. ****Bee damage decreased from +2 to +1. ****Tick changed from 0.75 > 0.5 to 0.75 ****Sting time changed from 4 > 6 to 5.25 > 5.5. ****Grenade damage increased from +0 to +20. ****Explosion range changed from 10 to 6 > 7. ***'''Level 5''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|4,000}} to {{Money|6,000}}. ****Firerate changed from {{Tooltip|1.025 > 0.525|-0.5}} to {{Tooltip|1.025 > 0.775|-0.25}}. ****Range decreased from +2 to +0. ****Damage increased from +0 to +10. ****Bee damage decreased from +2 to +1. ****Tick changed from 0.5 > 0.25 to 0.75 > 0.5. ****Sting time changed from 6 > 8 to 5.5 > 8. ****Grenade damage increased from +0 to +20. ****Explosion range changed from 10 to 7 > 8. *[[Space City]] remade. **Previous version has been kept in-game as [[Legacy Space City]]. **[[All Paths]] added. *[[Legacy Simplicity]] changed. **Name changed from ''Simplicity'' to ''Legacy Simplicity''. **Now is a community map. *[[Simplicity]] name changed from ''Simplicity Remaster'' to ''Simplicity''. **Anything that required or used [[Legacy Simplicity]] now requires or uses this map. *Admin mode gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|5,599}} to {{Robux|7,999}}. *Updated [[Biologist]] description. *[[Tutorial]] no longer allows the player to access the [[Settings]]. *Fixed [[Wox the Fox]], [[Gunslinger]], [[Fallen Swordmaster]] and [[Molten Boss]] getting stuck after using some of their abilities. *Fixed older enemies getting stuck once they targeted the [[Biologist]]. *Fixed [[Fallen Swordmaster]] ''Spike Summon'' ability spikes being invisible while also not stunning any towers. *Fixed modern [[Frost Spirit]] and [[Korblox Deathwalker (The Hunt: Mega Edition)|Korblox Deathwalker]] not using any of their abilities. *Fixed being able to stack [[Easter Egg]] firerate and [[Range Buff]]s. *Fixed [[Engineer]] sentries having lead detection. *Fixed [[Vigilante Crate]] skin bundle selling minies character gamepass from chwyle9's Place instead of the Vigilante Bundle gamepass from Tower Defense Simulator. *Fixed [[Swarmer]]'s firerate being twice as long. *Fixed [[Swarmer]]'s upgrade descriptions not listing most of the changes made to its statistics. :In '''v1.63.0a''': *Fixed Admin mode gifting still being discounted. ==Gallery==
